case.title: Wood build
case.request: Build a useful planter from the available boards, keeping cuts within stock and every joint executable.

design.purpose: A free-standing outdoor planter for herbs or flowers for one household, with about 15 cm usable soil depth above the base and drainage through base gaps and holes.

steps.c: Place the wide board flat for cutting.
Cut a 56 cm front and a 26 cm end; keep the offcut aside.
Place the second board flat for cutting.
Cut a 56 cm back and a 26 cm end; keep the offcut aside.
Place the narrow board flat for cutting.
Cut two 52 cm base slats; keep the offcut aside.
Sand all cut edges lightly.
Lay the first base slat flat.
Lay the second base slat beside the first, leaving a 0 cm drainage edge aligned.
Stand the front panel on the front edge of the base.
Stand the back panel on the back edge of the base.
Fit the first end between the front and back at the start.
Fit the second end between the front and back at the end.
Clamp the front to the first end.
Drive screws through the front into the first end.
Drive screws through the front into the second end.
Drive screws through the back into the first end.
Drive screws through the back into the second end.
Drill three drainage holes in each base slat.
Check the box is square and all panels are fixed.
